components.name: Button
components.summary: Pill button with a trailing arrow that extends on hover — use it for every call to action on marketing surfaces.
components.desc: Pill-shaped action button with the Heliograph animated arrow affix.

props.name: onDark
props.doc: Invert for placement on a dark surface.

components.example:
<Button variant="primary" size="lg">Get Started</Button>
<Button variant="secondary" size="lg">Learn More</Button>
components.notes:
- `variant`: primary (solid near-black on light / white on dark), secondary (7% tint), tertiary (transparent, no fill).
- `size`: lg (default) or sm — sm is what the top nav uses.
- `onDark`: flips the fill/text pairing for dark banners and footers.
- Labels are Title Case unless longer than five words. Arrow is always present; do not add your own icon.

components.name: CircleCheck
components.summary: Small circular checkmark icon used in bullet lists and feature callouts.
components.desc: SVG circle with an animated check — used inside BulletList items.

props.name: baseColor
props.doc: Fill pairing for light or dark surfaces.

components.notes: Always pair with a text label. Use baseColor="light" on dark surfaces.

components.name: LogoMark
components.summary: Mixpanel logo rendered as an image — full wordmark or standalone mark.
components.desc: Renders the Mixpanel logo from an asset file.

props.name: variant
props.doc: Full wordmark or just the logomark.

components.notes: Renders an tag. Height scales proportionally when set.

components.name: NavLink
components.summary: Inline text link with optional dropdown caret for navigation bars.
components.desc: Anchor-based nav link used in FullTopNav.
components.notes: Labels are children. Caret indicates a dropdown menu exists.

components.name: PlayHead
components.summary: 48px circular play button for video and media triggers.
components.desc: Pill-shaped play button with a rotated triangle icon.
components.notes: Follows RoundIconButton interactive token pattern. 48px fixed size with pill radius.

components.name: RoundIconButton
components.summary: Circular secondary-fill arrow button for stepping carousels.
components.desc: Circular arrow button — carousel and pagination control.
components.notes: Always used as a left/right pair. 32px (lg) or 24px (sm).

components.name: RoundMinusButton
components.summary: Circular minus button — collapse or remove-row control.
components.desc: Circular minus button — collapse or remove-row control.
components.notes: Same circular chassis as RoundIconButton — secondary fill, pill radius, 32/24px.

components.name: RoundPlusButton
components.summary: Circular plus button — expand or add-row control.
components.desc: Circular plus button — expand or add-row control.
components.notes: Same circular chassis as RoundIconButton — secondary fill, pill radius, 32/24px.

components.name: Tag
components.summary: Category / eyebrow chip — 4px radius, 1px border, tinted fill. Sits directly above a headline in a lockup.
components.desc: Small labelled chip used above headlines and inside cards.
components.notes: Seven hues (purple, pool, mint, lava, peach, mustard, grass). `onDark` swaps to the 20%-fill / light-text pairing.

components.name: TeamsIcon
components.summary: Three-person icon for team-related features and pricing tiers.
components.desc: SVG people icon with a lead figure and two side figures.
components.notes: Uses fill="currentColor" pattern. Colour inherits from parent.

components.name: Checkbox
components.summary: 16px checkbox, 4px radius. States: default, hover (purple border), focus (4px purple glow), checked (purple fill, white tick), error, disabled.
components.desc: 16px square checkbox with a purple checked fill.

props.name: error
props.doc: Error styling — lava border on a 20% lava fill.

components.name: Radio
components.summary: 18px radio. Same state ladder as Checkbox; selected state fills purple with a white centre dot.
components.desc: 18px radio control with a white dot on a purple fill when selected.

components.name: TextInput
components.summary: 36px field, 4px radius, 12px label text, purple caret.
components.desc: 36px-tall single-line text field.

props.name: error
props.doc: Lava border on a 20% lava fill.

props.name: valid
props.doc: Purple border plus a grass check icon.

components.example:
<TextInput placeholder="Work email" />
<TextInput valid defaultValue="ana@acme.com" />
<TextInput error defaultValue="not-an-email" />

components.name: Toggle
components.summary: 48x24 switch with a 20px thumb. On: purple track, white thumb, purple tick.
components.desc: 48x24 switch; the thumb carries a purple tick when on.

components.name: CoreTypeLockups
components.summary: The standard vertical text lockup — use it inside heroes, Z-layouts, footers and cards rather than hand-building headline stacks.
components.desc: Stacked tag + headline + subhead + button lockup. The backbone of every marketing section.

props.name: heading
props.doc: Visual heading size — selects the type scale.

props.name: headingTag
props.doc: Override the HTML heading tag independently of visual size, for SEO hierarchy.

props.name: hue
props.doc: Accent hue — drives tag color and on-dark headline tint.

components.example:
<CoreTypeLockups heading="H2" alignment="center" button includeSecondary
  headline="Analytics everyone can use" subhead="Answer product questions in seconds." />
components.notes: Max width 720px. Heading levels step down automatically at tablet and phone via `desktopSize`.

components.name: HorizontalCoreType
components.summary: Wide section header: text column left, actions bottom-aligned right. Use above card grids.
components.desc: Section header with the text on the left and the buttons pinned bottom-right.

props.name: heading
props.doc: Visual heading size — selects the type scale.

props.name: headingTag
props.doc: Override the HTML heading tag independently of visual size, for SEO hierarchy.

props.name: hue
props.doc: Accent hue — drives tag color and on-dark headline tint.

components.example: <HorizontalCoreType heading="H3" button headline="Customer stories" subhead="How teams ship faster with Mixpanel." />

components.name: AddedContent
components.summary: Flexible content slot that renders logos, quote, form, stats, or bullet list inside a section lockup.
components.desc: Switchable content block for embedding supplementary content (logo strip, inline quote, email form, stat, or bullet list) within larger sections.

props.name: hue
props.doc: Accent hue for on-dark headline tokens.

components.example:
<AddedContent content="logos" />
<AddedContent content="stats" value="10" suffix="M" description="Monthly tracked users" />
<AddedContent content="bullets" items={["Unlimited reports","Team dashboards","Data governance"]} />
components.notes: Designed to slot into CoreTypeLockups or hero sections as supplementary content. Uses Button, CircleCheck, and TextInput internally.

components.name: LgResourceCards
components.summary: Full-width resource / feature card. Light variants (gray, white) use a bordered surface; the six hue variants use the dark card gradient.
components.desc: Large split card: tag + headline + subhead + CTA beside an image panel.

props.name: children
props.doc: Replace the grey placeholder with real imagery.

components.example: <ResourceCard color="purple" imagePosition="left" alignment="left" headline="Read the guide" />

components.name: MdResourceCards
components.summary: Medium resource card with image, H4 headline, tag, subhead, and button lockup.
components.desc: Mid-size card with an image at top and CoreTypeLockups below. Supports light, muted, and six dark hue variants.

props.name: pageBackground
props.doc: Card surface. Hue values switch to dark gradient fill.

components.example:
<MdResourceCard pageBackground="light" tagText="Resources" headline="Read the guide" />
<MdResourceCard pageBackground="purple" headline="Dark variant" />
components.notes: Uses CoreTypeLockups (H4) internally. Card follows standard 24px outer radius, 8px border spacing, 16px image radius.

components.name: SmResourceCard
components.summary: Grid card — two variants: big-image (320px image area) or icon (24px icon). H6 headline, sm buttons.
components.desc: Vertical card for grids — big-image variant has a full-width image above content; icon variant has a small icon inline with the text lockup.

props.name: bigImage
props.doc: When true, renders a 320px image area above the content. When false, renders a 24px icon.

props.name: icon
props.doc: Icon for the icon layout variant.

props.name: includeButton
props.doc: When false, hides the action buttons.

components.name: MdProductCards
components.summary: Product card — 24px outer radius, 8px inner border spacing, 1:1 gradient panel, coloured glow shadow.
components.desc: Wide product card: text lockup on one side, a square gradient panel on the other.

props.name: color
props.doc: Gradient hue for the image panel.

components.notes: The gradient panel stands in for product imagery. Drop a real screenshot in its place when you have one.

components.name: LgProductCard
components.summary: Full-width section with a large horizontal product card. CoreTypeLockups (H3, tag, buttons) + 1:1 gradient image.
components.desc: Page-level section containing a single large card with content on one side and a square gradient image on the other. Uses CoreTypeLockups internally.
components.notes: Card has colored shadow glow per hue. Image area uses product-card gradient tokens. imagePosition flips content/image sides.

components.name: LogoCarousel
components.summary: Customer logo strip; 36s linear loop, masked at both edges. Logo slots are 112x27 placeholders — swap in real customer marks when licensed.
components.desc: Infinite-scrolling customer logo strip with edge mask.

components.name: FAQ
components.summary: Single expandable FAQ row with question, answer, and plus/minus toggle.
components.desc: Accordion-style FAQ item with RoundPlusButton/RoundMinusButton toggle.
components.example: <FAQ question="How does pricing work?" answer="Plans start at..." open />
components.notes: Controlled component — parent manages which item is open via onToggle. Uses RoundPlusButton and RoundMinusButton internally.

components.name: ButtonLockup
components.summary: Paired primary + secondary buttons in a horizontal row.
components.desc: Standard CTA button pair used across lockups and sections.
components.notes: Renders Button components internally. Pass children to override the default pair.

components.name: Stat
components.summary: Large stat number with suffix and description. H2 value + B1-medium suffix, B4 description.
components.desc: Displays a prominent stat value with an inline suffix and a short description line below. Supports on-dark with per-hue headline colours.

props.name: suffix
props.doc: Unit or label after the value.

components.notes: Typography: H2 value + B1-medium suffix baseline-aligned, B4 description. On-dark uses per-hue headline tokens.

components.name: FullTopNav
components.summary: The marketing site header. Translucent white with a blur, 1px bottom divider, sm buttons on the right.
components.desc: Sticky marketing top navigation — 64px tall, 80% white with an 18px backdrop blur.

props.name: desktopSize
props.doc: Responsive tier; controls horizontal margin and which controls show.

props.name: caretSrc
props.doc: Path to the dropdown caret icon.

props.name: burgerSrc
props.doc: Path to the burger menu icon.

props.name: onNavigate
props.doc: Callback when a nav link is clicked.

components.notes: Tablet and phone tiers collapse the link row into the burger. Link labels are 14px medium at 70% opacity, full opacity on hover.

components.name: LimitedTopNav
components.summary: Simplified top nav with logo and optional action buttons.
components.desc: Minimal navigation bar without nav links. Shows logo on left with optional login link and button lockup on right.
components.notes: Uses same visual treatment as FullTopNav (blur backdrop, 64px height, border-bottom) but without nav links or burger menu.

components.name: Footer
components.summary: Site footer. Carries the real Mixpanel IA (Platform / AI / Data / Teams / Industries / Resources / Company / Templates / Compare Us) — edit the arrays in the source if the sitemap changes.
components.desc: Site footer — CTA lockup over a four-column link card on a dark hero gradient.

props.name: includeCta
props.doc: Show the CTA lockup above the card.

props.name: logoSrc
props.doc: Path to the full Mixpanel logo.  — pass a path relative to YOUR page

components.notes: Group headers are UPPERCASE 12px at 70% white; every link carries a small chevron; "Pricing" is a pill link.

components.name: SmHero
components.summary: Sub-page hero. Uses the *light* hero gradient (fades to the hue at the bottom) rather than the dark homepage one.
components.desc: Sub-page hero: left text lockup beside a square image, on a light vertical gradient.
components.notes: Uses CoreTypeLockups at H2 visual size internally. LgHero uses H1.

components.name: LgHero
components.summary: The homepage hero. Fixed width per breakpoint (1440/1200/808/384), 24px banner radius, white radial ellipse behind the headline.
components.desc: Full-bleed homepage hero: nav, centred lockup, logo strip and a large product image well on a dark vertical gradient.

props.name: gradientStyle
props.doc: simple = one gradient; sliced = 11 stepped columns.

components.example: <LgHero color="purple" gradientStyle="sliced" headline="Build what people actually use" />

components.name: MdProductCardLockup
components.summary: Product overview section — the lockup sticks at 80px while the card column scrolls.
components.desc: Sticky text column beside a stacked column of ProductCards.

props.name: cards
props.type: { color?: string; headline?: string; subhead?: string }[]

props.name: subhead
props.def: "Bacon ipsum dolor amet flank brisket prosciutto, pork swine ham strip steak boudin bacon."

components.name: ZLayout
components.summary: Alternating feature row with text lockup and gradient image panel.
components.desc: Alternating feature row — text lockup one side, square gradient panel the other. Stack several and flip imagePosition to create a zigzag reading flow.

components.name: LgProductSection
components.summary: Large product section: headline lockup above a 2:1 gradient panel with optional sub-text blocks.
components.desc: Large product section with headline lockup, gradient panel, and optional caption blocks. Supports centered and horizontal layouts with the standard light/dark surface pattern.

props.name: headlineLayout
props.doc: Centred lockup or headline-left with button right.

props.name: color
props.doc: Accent hue — drives panel gradient, tag color, and on-dark surface.

props.name: subTextBlocks
props.doc: How many caption blocks sit under the panel.

components.name: SmContentCardLockup
components.summary: Section layout of SmResourceCards with an optional headline lockup.
components.desc: Full-width section that renders SmResourceCards in a responsive flex row.

props.name: includeHeadline
props.doc: Show the headline lockup above cards.

props.name: largeImage
props.doc: Big image cards instead of icon cards.

components.example: <SmContentCardLockup color="pool" pageBackground="dark" cards={3} headline="Latest resources" tagText="Blog" />
components.notes: Uses SmResourceCard components. CoreTypeLockups or HorizontalCoreType for the headline.

components.name: FAQs
components.summary: Accordion FAQ section with a title and expandable question-answer items.
components.desc: Full-width FAQ section with FAQ accordion rows.

props.name: items
props.def: [{question:"Add question in here...",answer:"Add answer in here..."}]

props.name: defaultOpen
props.doc: Index of the initially open item; -1 for all closed.

components.example: <FAQs items={[{question:"How does pricing work?",answer:"Plans start at..."}]} />
components.notes: Only one item is open at a time. Uses FAQ internally.

components.name: Quotes
components.summary: Customer quote carousel with attribution and clickable logo dots.
components.desc: Rotating testimonial section with blockquotes and navigation dots.

props.name: quotes
props.type: { quote: string; name: string; role?: string }[]
props.def: [{quote:"Mixpanel helps us enable our customers for success.",name:"Janna Sheng",role:"Product Manager"}]

components.notes: Pass children to add a media element beside the quote. Navigation dots act as quote selectors.

components.name: StatLockup
components.summary: Full-width section displaying a row of Stat components with optional headline.
components.desc: Page section showing 2–4 stat items in a flex row. Optionally includes a CoreTypeLockups (H3, center) headline above.
components.notes: Uses Stat and CoreTypeLockups internally. Stats flex equally across the row.

components.name: VideoLockup
components.summary: Full-width section with a 16:9 video frame, play button, and optional headline.
components.desc: Page section with a centered 900px video frame at 16:9 aspect ratio. PlayHead button overlays the center. Optionally includes a CoreTypeLockups (H3, center) headline above.

props.name: pageBackground
props.doc: Page surface. Dark switches to dark mode with the chosen hue.

components.notes: Uses PlayHead and CoreTypeLockups internally. Video frame has 16px border-radius.

components.name: LgContentCallout
components.summary: Large content callout with image panel and CoreTypeLockups + BulletList.
components.desc: Two-column section with a rounded image panel and a text lockup with bullet list for resource promotion.

props.name: pageBackground
props.doc: Page surface. Dark switches to dark mode with the chosen hue.

props.name: imagePosition
props.doc: Which side the image appears on.

props.name: content
props.doc: Content block below the type lockup.

props.name: items
props.doc: Bullet point strings for the BulletList.

components.example: <LgContentCallout headline="The definitive guide to product analytics" />
components.notes: Uses CoreTypeLockups and BulletList internally. Pass children for the image panel.
